title: SCA Minhag of the Week 231 "Tefilla BeSibbur: Pinehas, Matot, Masei & Debarim"

chapters.title: Minhagim for Parashat Pinehas
chapters.about: Maqam Saba, Brit, and Eliyahu haNavi

chapters.title: The number eight in the Torah

claims: He also reviews the musical traditions for Matot, Masei, and Debarim - He does not review the musical traditions for Matot or Masei, only mentioning Devarim (Maqam Hijaz) and mentioning the Haftarah/period connections.
summary: Mr. Harari discusses the minhagim for Parashat Pinehas, including the use of Maqam Saba and the association with Eliyahu haNavi. He also reviews the musical traditions for Matot, Masei, and Debarim, noting how these parashiyot relate to the calendar period of the three weeks and Tish'a BeAb.
questions: Why is Parashat Pinehas sung in Maqam Saba?
What is the connection between the number eight and the parashiyot in the Torah?
Why is Parashat Debarim sometimes called Shabbat Echa?
How does the timing of the Haftarah change based on the calendar?
